name: PdxErrorBoundary
description: Catches render errors and effect failures from its children and shows a fallback UI with retry.

members.name: maxRetries
members.description: Maximum retries before permanent fallback. 0 = no retry. Default: 3.

members.name: autoRetry
members.description: Auto-retry on error (no user action needed). Default: false.

members.name: retryDelay
members.description: Delay between auto-retries in ms. Default: 1000.

members.name: fallbackMessage
members.description: The fallback's message. Empty: the error-boundary.message component string, «Something went wrong.».

events.name: pdx-error
events.description: A child threw; the error, and how many retries have been made.

attributes.name: maxretries
attributes.description: Maximum retries before permanent fallback. 0 = no retry. Default: 3.

attributes.name: autoretry
attributes.description: Auto-retry on error (no user action needed). Default: false.

attributes.name: retrydelay
attributes.description: Delay between auto-retries in ms. Default: 1000.

attributes.name: fallbackmessage
attributes.description: The fallback's message. Empty: the error-boundary.message component string, «Something went wrong.».

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssParts.name: fallback
cssParts.description: The fallback shown in place of the children (`role="alert"`).

cssParts.name: message
cssParts.description: The fallback's message: `fallbackMessage`, or the component string.

cssParts.name: detail
cssParts.description: The error's own message, under it.

cssParts.name: retry
cssParts.description: The Retry button, while retries are left; the note that none are, after.

cssStates.name: error
cssStates.description: A child threw: the fallback shows. Cleared when Retry brings the children back.
